dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, thin-lined light-grey perimeters forming 'C' and 'O' shapes in the mid-lateral field, featuring a sharp gradient transition from the dark background to the high-intensity line edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse density of localized, small high-intensity pixel clusters appearing as discrete points rather than large solid masses, primarily situated within the perimeters of the larger annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four primary mid-body annuli define an irregular quadrilateral, while anterior points follow a curved trajectory towards the nuchal region.

other_distinctive_markers: A fine-gauge, interlocking network of light-colored lines on the shoulder and neck, forming a reticulated mesh pattern that is visually distinct from the larger posterior annular structures.
